dcterms:description: The Arcade Learning Environment (ALE) is a benchmark for evaluating general agents in reinforcement learning, consisting of various Atari games.
dcterms:title: Arcade Learning Environment

dcterms:description: A set of continuous control tasks from OpenAI Gym, including environments like HalfCheetah, Hopper, and Walker2D, used for evaluating reinforcement learning algorithms.
dcterms:title: OpenAI Gym Continuous Control Environments

dcterms:description: A set of sparse reward environments modified from rllab, including SparseCartpoleSwingup and SparseDoublePendulum, used to evaluate exploration strategies in reinforcement learning.
dcterms:title: Sparse Reward Environments from rllab
